member.name: M:MeSoft.MeCom.PhyWrapper.IMeComPhy.GetDataOrTimeout(System.IO.MemoryStream)
member.summary: Tries to read data from the physical interface or throws an timeout exception.
member.remarks: Reads the available data in the physical interface buffer and returns immediately. If the receiving buffer is empty, it tries to read at least one byte. It will wait till the timeout occurs if nothing is received. Must probably be called several times to receive the whole frame.
member.param: Stream where data will be added to.
member.exception: Thrown when the underlying physical interface is not OK.
Thrown when 0 bytes were received during the specified timeout time.
